_note: 2026-10-30. Material model per object for NVIDIA's public scans (track_3/public/mesh). Materials from the public videos (ep0, ep12, ep18, ep21, ep24 frames): pot, lid, cups, pitcher, dish rack and dust pan are rigid plastic; the boards are light wood. Densities: polypropylene 900 kg/m3, pine/plywood 550 kg/m3. Wall thicknesses are estimates (2-2.5 mm moulded household plastic; boards 8.5 mm, docs/research/notes/15). area_factor 0.5 where the scan carries both faces of a plate or lattice (lid, dust pan, rack, boards); 1.0 for containers scanned from outside (scan area close to the outer area). Every mass is an ESTIMATE, plausibly within x0.6-x1.6. The sweeper (brush: block + bristles) has no geometric model: stated prior. No ground truth is used.
